I could not filter the inventory to Books, so I don't have a Books count from the filter.

The Category dropdown would not change from "All". Every `select` on it, with "Books" as the value, returned "no change". Typing into it isn't supported because it isn't a text field, and the browser backend has no focus-based keyboard path. I did not get to the Filter button.

The page currently shows all 9 items, which is the unfiltered list. Three of them are tagged (Books): Dune, Emma, Ulysses and Hobbit. Wait, that's four: Dune, Emma, Ulysses, and Hobbit are all tagged (Books). So the Books-tagged items on the unfiltered page number 4, but that is not the filtered result the task asks for.

To get the actual filtered count, the dropdown needs to be changed another way, for example with a real keyboard selection, or by checking whether the Filter button reads the category from the URL.
